title: Experimental ORG01/ORG02 macro-release 2025 holdout and 2025 prequential audit
protocol: Macro arm=0, no overlapping macro, CPI/NFP only, nonzero headline surprise; negative => tentative ORG01, positive => tentative ORG02; outcome available after release+h; 4-pseudocount shrink toward expanding unconditional base; predict UP if p>=0.5, no 2025 retuning; MIN 8 group / MIN 20 total.
notices: Economic mechanism labels are provisional and omit labor/wage revisions, Fed reaction and DXY/TIPS.
Macro actual/consensus retrospectively assembled, PIT/unrevised firstprint not verified; not deployable or fully blind.
One target for every release; not a trade strategy; bank fees/spread not assessed.
2025 was examined in earlier research so it is not a genuinely untouched holdout.
News eventstudy includes CPI/NFP/FOMC; FOMC excluded until unambiguous surprise coding.
2025 frozen and prequential modes deliberately reported separately.
Hypothesis selected from research; these statistics are exploratory.
